facts.summary: Primary lesion-growth endpoint missed, vision preservation positive · Phase 2 · ANX007 in geographic atrophy · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The primary endpoint of mean rate of change (slope) in GA lesion area compared to sham at 12 months did not reach statistical significance.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The primary endpoint of mean rate of change (slope) in GA lesion area compared to sham at 12 months did not reach statistical significance.
evidence.safety: Treatment with ANX007 was generally well-tolerated in the 181 GA patients treated either monthly or every other month.
evidence.program_discontinued: Based on the ARCHER trial results, we plan to engage with regulators to determine the optimal path forward to bring ANX007 to patients as expeditiously as possible.
